lines.zh: 我颠着小步子，滚过草地。
lines.en: I bounce along in little steps across the grass.

lines.zh: 我身子很圆，走起来一晃一晃。
lines.en: I am round, and I rock as I go.
I hop once, then hop again.

lines.zh: 我跟在一群同伴后面蹦。
lines.en: I bounce along behind a group of my kind.
I hop over toward your feet.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方草被压出小坑。
lines.en: Small dents appear where I pass.
I hop over a little twig.

lines.zh: 我一边跳一边左看右看。
lines.en: I hop while looking left and right.
I roll slowly in front of you.
I pause, then keep bouncing.
I bounce out of the grass.
I wobble along after you.
I sit with my belly on the ground.
I blink slowly.
I open my mouth, waiting to be fed.

lines.zh: 我团成球，在草地上歇着。
lines.en: I ball up and rest on the grass.

lines.zh: 我在看飞过去的一只虫。
lines.en: I watch an insect fly past.
I make a tiny sound.

lines.zh: 我把自己团得更圆一点。
lines.en: I tuck myself rounder.
I doze against a stone.
I twitch my short ears.
I open my small mouth and close it.
I rub around on the grass.

lines.zh: 我把圆身子撑起来一点。
lines.en: I prop my round body up a little.
I lie by the flowers without moving.
I count the companions ahead of me.
Are you the big one?
I look up at you, quite in earnest.
Will you give me something to eat?

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，我认下了。
lines.en: I have accepted your smell as known.
Where are you rolling me off to?
I roll to your feet and stop.
I chirp once, quietly.

lines.zh: 我歪着小脑袋仰头看你。
lines.en: I tip my little head up at you.
Crouch low and I will come over.
I am still soft.
My arms are short; I cannot reach.
Do you want to pet me?
My belly gave a little gurgle.
I wait for your hand to come down.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我就要蹦三下。
lines.en: One step of yours takes me three hops.
My eyes are big; you can see them.
I cry out and roll away.
I ball up and roll aside.
I flip over, legs flailing.
I shake and my eyes go wide.
I roll slowly back to your feet.
That stung a little.
I tuck my head in.
I keep making small cries.
I roll into the grass and hide.
I roll twice before stopping.
Is there any in-training feed?
I caught that smell.
I push toward your palm.
I wait, drool dripping onto the grass.
I have had my mouth open a while.
That piece is bigger than me.
I hop twice, impatient.
What you hold smells good.
I wait, drooling.

lines.zh: 我够不到，就在你脚边转。
lines.en: I can't reach it, so I circle your feet.
I squeeze toward your feet.
I wait for small bites.

lines.zh: 你碰我一下，我滚了半圈。
lines.en: You touch me and I roll half a turn.
I hit your boot and bounce back.
We bump and I sit down.
I press against your ankle.
You step on me; I am unhurt.

lines.zh: 我被撞得翻过去，四脚朝天。
lines.en: I am flipped onto my back.
I roll slowly back.
You lift your foot and I slip under.
I hit a stone and rebound.
After we part, I shake myself.
I am too small; much too early.
I will wait until I grow.
Give me something to eat first.
I roll off to the grass edge.
I shake my head and roll away.
I cannot make out such talk.
I squeeze into the group.
I am small; not suited to this.
I hop twice and stop.
I look at you with my mouth open.
I bite it and drag it back.
I hug it and roll once.

lines.zh: 我拖不动，就坐在它上面。
lines.en: I can't drag it, so I sit on it.
I nibble until my face is covered in crumbs.
My mouth is full and I'm still hopping.
Can this thing be eaten?
I drag it over by the flowers.
I sniff whatever falls first.
I nudge it to your feet.

lines.zh: 我拿牙磨了两下，放弃了。
lines.en: I gnaw twice, then give up.

lines.zh: 我圆眼睛盯着你手里的袋子。
lines.en: My round eyes fix on your bag.
I am going to follow you.
I take you as a companion.
I bounce in front of you.
That smell is this way.

lines.zh: 你的样子我记在小脑袋里。
lines.en: Your shape is stored in my little head.
I start bouncing along after you.
I roll over to your side.

lines.zh: 你的口袋有幼年期饲料味。
lines.en: Your pocket smells of baby feed.
I roll toward this smell.
I look up at you, waiting for you to go.
You lead; I will roll after.
I keep at your heels.
You take a step; I hop two.
I bounce while watching you.
You stop and I bump into you.

lines.zh: 我短腿一蹬，滚到你前面。
lines.en: My short legs kick and I roll ahead of you.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地跟着你的味道。
lines.en: I follow your scent slowly.
You look back and I am looking up.
Slower please; my short legs cannot keep up.
I bounce along at your feet.
You get far and I run.
I tire of hopping and rest.
I wait for you to move on.
I give you a soft nudge.
I bite and miss.
That one rolled me over first.
I bounce up and hit your ankle.
I catch your lace and hold.
That felt like being hit by a ball.
I strike and roll aside.
I hop in and bump your knee.
I am too small to do more than touch.
I chirp as I bump you.
You back off, and so do I.
I bumped lightly, no force.

lines.zh: 草里滚出一个小小的东西。
lines.en: Something small rolls out of the grass.

lines.zh: 我从蛋壳的碎片里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of the eggshell pieces.

lines.zh: 你先听到一声很轻的叫。
lines.en: You hear a tiny cry first.
I bounce up before you and stop.
I roll out from beside your pack.
I raise my head and look at the world.

lines.zh: 我落在草地上，弹了两下。
lines.en: I land on the grass and bounce twice.

lines.zh: 一群小的从坡上滚下来。
lines.en: A group of little ones rolls down the slope.
I rub against your feet.
I shake off the bits of shell.
I sit on the ground and wait.
I cry out as I roll.
The heat makes me bounce very high.

lines.zh: 我从高处滚下来，撞了两次。
lines.en: I roll down from a height and hit twice.
Water closes over me and I strain upward.

lines.zh: 气浪把我吹得翻了三个跟头。
lines.en: The blast sends me tumbling three times over.

lines.zh: 箭把我钉在地上，我挣不动。
lines.en: An arrow pins me to the ground and I cannot move.
A spell passes and I go dizzy.
I have no strength left to hop.
The strike rolls me far.
The void draws me and I roll further away.
